newsitem.title: CHINA: China trust firm gets $50 mln foreign bank loan.
newsitem.headline: China trust firm gets $50 mln foreign bank loan.

text.p: The Guangdong Overseas Chinese Trust and Investment Co has obtained a $50 million five-year loan from a consortium of foreign banks, a company official said on Wednesday.

"We will re-lend the funds to finance several key projects in Guangdong province," an official at Guangdong Overseas said by telephone from the company's headquarters in Guangzhou, capital of the southern province.
He did not give further details of the projects or the terms of the loan.
The bank group includes BZW-Barclays Bank Plc and several commercial banks from Germany, Japan and South Korea, the official said without elaborating.
